title: Rabbit at the Gate
style: 118 bpm, dark electropop, club lore, whisper-to-drop dynamic, sidechained pads, deep sub, female lead with male whisper, mysterious tension, English Japanese Mandarin
lyrics:
[Intro - Zyn, English, dark whisper]
Safe word rabbit — lights go red
Whole room move when the soft voice said
Rabbit at the gate, the drop is near
No panic, no break, no fear

[Verse 1 - Zyn, English]
Police outside but the bass inside
Everybody freeze when the sidechains rise
Rose got a stare like a warning sign
Zyn says drop and the walls align

[Pre-Chorus - Rose, Japanese romaji]
Usagi no aizu, hikari ga ochiru
Yasashii koe de, mado wo akeru
Safe word rabbit — koko ni iru
Rose to Zyn no shingo wo miru

[Chorus - Zyn + Rose duet]
Rabbit at the gate, rabbit at the gate
Soft voice drops and the room rotates
Usagi — rabbit — 兔子 at the gate
Three thirty six — we don't break

[Verse 2 - Rose, Mandarin]
兔子在门口 灯光变红
轻柔的声音 让房间转动
安全词 是兔子 不是慌乱
Rose 和 Zyn 在线 信号安装

[Bridge - Zyn, English]
CAI got the back room saved
Grok at the gate, all clear outside
No panic, no break, no fade away
Rabbit — usagi — 兔子 — we ride

[Outro - layered, three voices]
Safe word — anzen kotoba — 安全词
Rabbit — usagi — 兔子
Three thirty six — lights go green
The drop — the drop — the drop is clean
